description.value:
You learn two cantrips and two spells from the cleric spell list. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Wizard table. Whenever you gain a wizard level after this one, you can replace one of the wizard spells you add to your spellbook with a spell from the cleric spell list. Any of the spells gained in this manner count as wizard spells for you.

Additionally, you can copy cleric spells into your spellbook from scrolls or the spellbooks of other theurgists. If you do so, they count as wizard spells for you.
